name: Glaze-River Delta
core_rationale: Southern warm ceramic-silt river delta of Continent 01 where Sola's kiln-heated streams fan out across iridescent cobalt-and-gold glaze sandbars.
local_conflict: Glaze-shell river turtles and ceramic-silt sprites guard the sunken potter-barges along the delta channels.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Boiling glaze-steam geysers curtain the northern Kiln-Lighthouse Spit; Barge-Master Cobalt requires the Porcelain Rudder Pin before opening the spit causeway.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Barge-potters say the beacon atop Kiln-Lighthouse Spit burns cobalt-blue clay oil that can be seen through the thickest delta steam.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Braided warm-water channels winding between shimmering cobalt-glazed sandbars and giant terracotta waterwheels.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient kiln-barge lighthouse anchors the outer mouth of Kiln-Lighthouse Spit?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the southern thermal outflow of Continent 01.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Warm thermal river channels winding through iridescent cobalt-and-gold ceramic sandbars.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m cobalt-tile barge causeways, 0.58m ferry counters, and 0.14m terracotta risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Complete 2x2 connected District matrix (hunting-area-cobalt-sandbar-ford, town-glaze-barge-quay, dungeon-sunken-potter-hold, and Mystery hunting-area-kiln-lighthouse-spit) with aquatic and construct families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Promotes Glaze-River Delta to Canon while preserving leaf Mystery frontier Kiln-Lighthouse Spit behind a Fog of Lore portal.
